title: BLR CSP constraint
statement: Let $x$ and $y$ be functions from an $n$-element index set to the field with two elements. The associated constraint uses the linear equation whose right-hand side is zero: if $x=0$, $y=0$, or $x=y$, it has arity one and scope consisting of the zero function; otherwise it has arity three and scope $(x,y,x+y)$.
hypotheses_covered: Two functions from an $n$-element index set to the field with two elements
